# NewsCatcher

> NewsCatcher is news search and news research for applications and AI agents, in every language. The News API answers in seconds: ranked articles grouped into stories for the last 30 days (`/search`), or every article that matches a boolean query over the last 12 months (`/articles`). The Agent does research that takes minutes and returns a table: every event of a kind (deals, layoffs, recalls, funding rounds) checked against its sources, or the news stories of each company in a list. Monitors repeat agent research on a schedule and deliver only what is new.

**Important notes:**

- One account, one API key and one balance of NCC credits pay for both products. Only successful work is charged.
- News API: `https://api.newscatcherapi.com/news-api`. Agent API: `https://api.newscatcherapi.com/agent`. Send the key in the `x-api-key` header.
- `/search` returns the best articles, not every match. For every match, an exact count or news older than 30 days, use `/articles`.
- Agent runs are asynchronous: `POST /runs` answers `202` with a `run_id`; poll `GET /runs/{run_id}` until `status` is `succeeded`, `failed` or `cancelled`.
- `GET /subscription` is free and returns your plan, limits and credit balance.

## Which route to use

- **An agent setting NewsCatcher up for a person:** read and follow [Onboarding for AI agents](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/agent-onboarding.md). It connects, verifies the key and lists the queries that fail silently.
- **From Claude.ai or Claude Desktop:** add a custom connector with the URL `https://mcp.newscatcherapi.com/mcp` and sign in. Setup: [MCP server](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/integrations/mcp.md)
- **In Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add Newscatcher/newscatcher-mcp`, then `/plugin install newscatcher@newscatcher`, or add the server with `claude mcp add --transport http newscatcher https://mcp.newscatcherapi.com/mcp`.
- **In Cursor:** install NewsCatcher from the Cursor Marketplace, or add the MCP server to `~/.cursor/mcp.json`.
- **In any other MCP client:** add `https://mcp.newscatcherapi.com/mcp` with the `x-api-key` header (see MCP server below).
- **In your own app or pipeline:** call the REST APIs (see API Reference below). Start with the [Quickstart](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/get-started/quickstart.md).
- **To choose between a search, an agent run and a monitor:** [Choose an API](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/get-started/choose-an-api.md).
- **To check prices or limits:** [Credits and pricing](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/get-started/credits-and-pricing.md) and [Rate limits](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/get-started/rate-limits.md).

## MCP server

Gives any MCP client tools to search the news, list every matching article, count articles over time, read a story, start and read agent runs, manage company lists and monitors, and check the account. Hosted, open source under the MIT license.

- Hosted server: `https://mcp.newscatcherapi.com/mcp` (streamable HTTP). Sign in with a NewsCatcher account, or send an API key in the `x-api-key` header.
- Load only some toolsets with `?tools=`: `news`, `research`, `lists`, `monitors` (for example `?tools=news,research`).
- [MCP server documentation](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/integrations/mcp.md)
- [MCP server repository](https://github.com/Newscatcher/newscatcher-mcp): includes a plugin for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex with skills for common news tasks

## Authentication

Every request takes an API key in the `x-api-key` header. Create a key in the [NewsCatcher platform](https://platform.newscatcherapi.com). The MCP server also takes sign-in with a NewsCatcher account.

- [Authentication](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/get-started/authentication.md)
- [Errors](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/get-started/errors.md)

## API Reference

Parameters and response schema of every endpoint, as Markdown.

### News API

- [Search news](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/api-reference/search/search-news.md): `GET /search`
- [Search news (JSON body)](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/api-reference/search/search-news-json-body.md): `POST /search`
- [Get a story and its articles](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/api-reference/search/get-a-story-and-its-articles.md): `GET /stories/{story_id}`
- [List the articles that match a query](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/api-reference/articles/list-the-articles-that-match-a-query.md): `GET /articles`
- [List the articles that match a query (JSON body)](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/api-reference/articles/list-the-articles-that-match-a-query-json-body.md): `POST /articles`
- [Get subscription info](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/api-reference/subscription/get-subscription-info.md): `GET /subscription`

### Agent

- [Create Run](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/api-reference/runs/create-run.md): `POST /runs`
- [List Runs](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/api-reference/runs/list-runs.md): `GET /runs`
- [Get Run](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/api-reference/runs/get-run.md): `GET /runs/{run_id}`
- [Stream Run Events](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/api-reference/runs/stream-run-events.md): `GET /runs/{run_id}/progress`
- [Cancel Run](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/api-reference/runs/cancel-run.md): `POST /runs/{run_id}/cancel`
- [Rename Run](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/api-reference/runs/rename-run.md): `PATCH /runs/{run_id}`
- [Delete Run](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/api-reference/runs/delete-run.md): `DELETE /runs/{run_id}`
- [Continue Run](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/api-reference/runs/continue-run.md): `POST /runs/{run_id}/continue`
- [Copy Run](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/api-reference/runs/copy-run.md): `POST /runs/{run_id}/copy`
- [Deliver Run Webhooks](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/api-reference/runs/deliver-run-webhooks.md): `POST /runs/{run_id}/webhooks/deliver`
- [Export Run Csv](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/api-reference/runs/export-run-csv.md): `GET /runs/{run_id}/export.csv`
- [Export Run Xlsx](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/api-reference/runs/export-run-xlsx.md): `GET /runs/{run_id}/export.xlsx`
- [Export Companies Csv](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/api-reference/runs/export-companies-csv.md): `GET /runs/{run_id}/companies.csv`
- [Export Companies Xlsx](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/api-reference/runs/export-companies-xlsx.md): `GET /runs/{run_id}/companies.xlsx`
- [Get Batch](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/api-reference/runs/get-batch.md): `GET /batches/{batch_id}`
- [Stream Batch](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/api-reference/runs/stream-batch.md): `GET /batches/{batch_id}/progress`
- [Cancel Batch](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/api-reference/runs/cancel-batch.md): `POST /batches/{batch_id}/cancel`
- [Rename Batch](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/api-reference/runs/rename-batch.md): `PATCH /batches/{batch_id}`
- [Delete Batch](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/api-reference/runs/delete-batch.md): `DELETE /batches/{batch_id}`
- [Export Batch Csv](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/api-reference/runs/export-batch-csv.md): `GET /batches/{batch_id}/export.csv`
- [Export Batch Xlsx](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/api-reference/runs/export-batch-xlsx.md): `GET /batches/{batch_id}/export.xlsx`
- [Export Batch Companies Csv](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/api-reference/runs/export-batch-companies-csv.md): `GET /batches/{batch_id}/companies.csv`
- [Export Batch Companies Xlsx](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/api-reference/runs/export-batch-companies-xlsx.md): `GET /batches/{batch_id}/companies.xlsx`
- [List Lists](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/api-reference/company-lists/list-lists.md): `GET /companies/lists`
- [Create List](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/api-reference/company-lists/create-list.md): `POST /companies/lists`
- [Upload List](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/api-reference/company-lists/upload-list.md): `POST /companies/lists/upload`
- [List From Run](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/api-reference/company-lists/list-from-run.md): `POST /companies/lists/from-run/{run_id}`
- [Get List](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/api-reference/company-lists/get-list.md): `GET /companies/lists/{list_id}`
- [Rename List](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/api-reference/company-lists/rename-list.md): `PATCH /companies/lists/{list_id}`
- [Delete List](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/api-reference/company-lists/delete-list.md): `DELETE /companies/lists/{list_id}`
- [Add Companies](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/api-reference/company-lists/add-companies.md): `POST /companies/lists/{list_id}/companies`
- [Upload Companies](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/api-reference/company-lists/upload-companies.md): `POST /companies/lists/{list_id}/companies/upload`
- [Correct Company](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/api-reference/company-lists/correct-company.md): `PATCH /companies/lists/{list_id}/companies/{domain}`
- [Remove Company](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/api-reference/company-lists/remove-company.md): `DELETE /companies/lists/{list_id}/companies/{domain}`
- [Create Monitor](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/api-reference/monitors/create-monitor.md): `POST /monitors`
- [List Monitors](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/api-reference/monitors/list-monitors.md): `GET /monitors`
- [Get Monitor](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/api-reference/monitors/get-monitor.md): `GET /monitors/{monitor_id}`
- [Update Monitor](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/api-reference/monitors/update-monitor.md): `PATCH /monitors/{monitor_id}`
- [Delete Monitor](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/api-reference/monitors/delete-monitor.md): `DELETE /monitors/{monitor_id}`
- [Run Monitor Now](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/api-reference/monitors/run-monitor-now.md): `POST /monitors/{monitor_id}/run`
- [Deliver Monitor Webhooks](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/api-reference/monitors/deliver-monitor-webhooks.md): `POST /monitors/{monitor_id}/webhooks/deliver`
- [Monitor Runs](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/api-reference/monitors/monitor-runs.md): `GET /monitors/{monitor_id}/runs`
- [Get Monitor Run](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/api-reference/monitors/get-monitor-run.md): `GET /monitors/runs/{run_id}`
- [Monitor Stories](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/api-reference/monitors/monitor-stories.md): `GET /monitors/{monitor_id}/stories`
- [Monitor Rows](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/api-reference/monitors/monitor-rows.md): `GET /monitors/{monitor_id}/rows`
- [Export Monitor Run Csv](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/api-reference/monitors/export-monitor-run-csv.md): `GET /monitors/runs/{run_id}/export.csv`
- [Export Monitor Run Xlsx](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/api-reference/monitors/export-monitor-run-xlsx.md): `GET /monitors/runs/{run_id}/export.xlsx`

## Documentation

Every page is available as Markdown: the links below end in `.md`. Drop `.md` for the web page. Cite the page URLs, not this file.

- Docs MCP server: `https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/mcp` searches and reads these docs from any MCP client.

### Get started

- [NewsCatcher API](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/get-started/overview.md): Search the world's news in any language, or let the agent research events and companies for you.
- [Quickstart](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/get-started/quickstart.md): Get an API key and make your first News API search and agent run.
- [Onboarding for AI agents](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/agent-onboarding.md): One page an AI agent reads to connect to NewsCatcher, pick the right tool, avoid the queries that fail silently and check its credits.
- [Choose an API](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/get-started/choose-an-api.md): When to use a News API search, an agent run or a monitor.
- [Authentication](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/get-started/authentication.md): Send your API key in the x-api-key header.
- [Credits and pricing](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/get-started/credits-and-pricing.md): What each search, story and agent run costs, and when you are not charged.
- [Enterprise plans](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/get-started/enterprise-plans.md): Everything Enterprise plans add to the News API and the agent.
- [Rate limits and plan limits](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/get-started/rate-limits.md): Requests per second, daily limits, result limits and history on your plan.
- [Errors](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/get-started/errors.md): Error responses, what they mean and when to retry.

### News API

- [News API quickstart](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/news/quickstart.md): Search the last 30 days of news in any language with one request.
- [Effort levels](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/news/effort-levels.md): Choose how much work goes into ranking, and what a search costs.
- [Writing queries](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/news/writing-queries.md): Ask in plain words or keywords, in any language, and exclude terms with NOT.
- [Stories](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/news/stories.md): How articles are grouped into stories, and how to get every article of one story.
- [Articles](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/news/articles.md): List articles over the last 12 months, and page through the results.
- [Filters and sorting](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/news/filters.md): Narrow a search by time window, language, country, publisher, coverage and content type, and choose the order of the results.
- [Response fields](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/news/response-fields.md): Every field of a search response, an articles response and an article.
- [Best practices](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/news/best-practices.md): Get better results and spend fewer credits with the News API.
- [How to evaluate the News API](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/news/evaluate-search.md): Measure search quality on your own queries before you integrate.

### Agent

- [Agent overview](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/agent/overview.md): Research events or companies in the background, once or on a schedule.
- [Agent quickstart](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/agent/quickstart.md): Start a run, follow it, and download the result.
- [Event research](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/agent/event-research.md): Turn a description of events into a verified table, one event per row.
- [Company research](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/agent/company-research.md): Find each company's news stories from a list of domains.
- [Company lists](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/agent/company-lists.md): Save the companies you follow, fix how they resolve, and reuse them in runs and monitors.
- [Monitors](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/agent/monitors.md): Repeat research on a schedule and get only what is new.
- [Runs](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/agent/runs.md): Follow, cancel, rename and delete runs, and work with batches.
- [Results and exports](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/agent/results-and-exports.md): Read a run's table, and download it as CSV or Excel.
- [Best practices](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/agent/best-practices.md): Write better requests, pick the right mode and keep monitors cheap.

### Integrations

- [MCP server](https://www.newscatcherapi.com/docs/integrations/mcp.md): Use the News API and the agent from Claude, Cursor and other MCP clients.
